name: Fantasy Network
description:
About This Game

WELCOME TO THE NETWORK – THE WORLD’S FIRST SOCIAL MEDIA METROIDVANIA

Explore. Fight. Post.

Fantasy Network turns the metroidvania genre upside down, combining tight 2D platforming with a satirical story about fame, influencers, and saving the world.

Lyn’s morning is officially ruined: her mother has been kidnapped! The ransom? Victory in the President’s Race.

To save her family, Lyn must win vicious talent shows, honing her skills to a razor's edge. Travel through the colorful lands of Holua, battle bizarre enemies, make friends across her journey, and dig up the ancient truth buried beneath the world’s shiny surface.

HELP LYN FULFILL HER MISSION IN A COLORFUL, HAND-DRAWN ACTION ADVENTURE!

  • A world without limits

    Interconnected map filled with hidden shortcuts, secret zones, and eccentric NPCs. Explore evocative environments ranging from sunny beaches and scorching volcanoes to freezing glaciers and ancient temples- you’ll even blast off into cosmic space!

  • Acrobatic skills

    Enjoy a challenging gameplay loaded with action with jumps, double-jumps, somersaults, and rapid dashes in its platformer levels.

  • Fluid combat

    Take on a colorful variety of enemies using your umbrella. Switch between its various configurations to adapt to any threat.

  • The influencer lifestyle

    Keep in constant touch with Holua's citizens via social apps. Chat for intel, post photos of your adventures, and gather likes to grow your fan base.

  • Shop & scroll

    Collect Crebits (the world's electronic currency) to buy new equipment, download essential smartphone apps, and purchase travel tickets to enjoy city attractions.

  • Win the presidency

    It’s not just about fighting- compete in cooking, racing, gaming, dance, and fashion talent shows. Win them all to become the new President of Holua!

  • Uncover the mystery

    Dive into side quests to piece together the complete history of Holua and reveal the incredible secret that its inhabitants are completely unaware of.

  • Retro downtime

    Need a break from adventuring? Chill out with four playable retro pixel-art arcade games or just hang out with the locals.

This isn't just a fantasy game. It's a colorful, glitchy, hilarious critique of the screen you're looking at right now.
short_desc: Join Lyn in a colorful, cartoonish world of Holua where "Likes" are the ultimate power! Explore a non-linear world, master umbrella-based combat, and smash your way through talent-show boss battles. It’s a metroidvania with a social media soul- no subscription needed.
